note: Frozen hand-labelled set, 2026-11-22. 30 rules from 5 survey folders (memory + CLAUDE.md, ADR 0009), drawn by prep/sample_label_set.py (seed 2520). Claude and Codex labelled independently from rule text and file name only (prompts/review/label_guide.md); 20 agreed (Z3 same meaning); the author settled 10 (D1-D10: AABBABAAAA). Rules where the labellers disagreed are marked ambiguous: they are reported as a result group, with both readings. Do not edit; a change needs a new file and a note.
